author: Antigravity Research Team
objective: Investigate whether parent-job-aware historical context improves failure detection and false-alarm control in the Google Borg workload prediction project without leaking future or sibling runtime state.

safeguards.training_partition: Candidate A Train (N=3,278 windows across 51 parent jobs)
safeguards.validation_partition: Candidate A Validation (N=657 windows across 12 parent jobs)
safeguards.causality_enforcement: Strictly prior observations (t_prior < t_pred) within the respective job/entity. No concurrent or future telemetry.

experiment_a.name: Parent-Job Historical Baseline (CE Loss, alpha=InvFreq, gamma=0)
experiment_a.baseline_definition: For each window at t_pred, compute baseline (mean, std) from all prior observations across the parent job strictly before t_pred (t_prior < t_pred). If K_job >= 2, apply normalization. Otherwise, fall back to frozen Phase 7C cluster scaler.
experiment_a.loss: CrossEntropyLoss with training-only inverse-frequency weights w = [1.0, 11.464, 11.796]

experiment_b.name: Hierarchical Causal Baseline (CE Loss, alpha=InvFreq, gamma=0)
experiment_b.baseline_definition: For each window at t_pred: (1) If current task has K_task >= 2 prior windows (t_prior < t_pred), use task baseline; (2) Else if parent job has K_job >= 2 prior windows across any entity in the job (t_prior < t_pred), use parent-job baseline; (3) Else fall back to frozen Phase 7C cluster scaler.
experiment_b.loss: CrossEntropyLoss with training-only inverse-frequency weights w = [1.0, 11.464, 11.796]

experiment_c.name: Best Baseline (A or B) + Focal Loss (gamma=1.0, alpha=InvFreq)
experiment_c.baseline_definition: Input tensor constructed using the best-justified baseline from Experiment A or B.

operational_acceptance_gates.eligibility_rule: A model is operationally eligible ONLY if it satisfies BOTH Gate 1 and Gate 2 simultaneously. Higher Macro-F1 alone does not qualify it.
